overview: Based on the published agenda, this special Board of Trustees meeting for the Village of Maine was scheduled to address fire department officer elections, hold a public hearing on the 2027 budget and consider its adoption, set the village's 2026 tax levy, and approve an emergency medical responder. The meeting was set to occur in mid-November 2026.
committee: Board of Trustees, Village of Maine

agenda.item: Discussion & Possible Action – Fire Department Officer Elections
Discussion & Possible Action – Adoption of the 2027 Budget
Discussion & Possible Action – Resolution 2026-04 setting the Village of Maine's 2026 Tax Levy Payable in 2027
Discussion & Possible Action – Approve EMR Carrie Genrich
Public Comment regarding Other Business items, limited to three minutes

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on elections for fire department officers. No additional details were provided in the agenda regarding the positions or candidates.

The village was set to hold a public hearing on the proposed 2027 budget, followed by board discussion and possible action on its adoption. This hearing was scheduled to allow community members to comment on the village's spending plans for the upcoming fiscal year.

The board was scheduled to discuss and consider possible action on Resolution 2026-04, which would set the Village of Maine's 2026 tax levy payable in 2027. This action was expected to establish the property tax amount for residents.

discussions.item: Emergency Medical Responder Carrie Genrich Approval
discussions.body: The board was set to discuss and take possible action to approve Carrie Genrich as an emergency medical responder for the village. No additional details regarding the position or circumstances were provided in the agenda.
